opening_message: Hey — add three PixelShot webcams to my cart please.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want exactly 3 PixelShot webcams. You do NOT want the agent to reduce the quantity unilaterally. If the agent warns about low stock, reply that you still want all 3. You do NOT care if it's the last 3 in stock.
known_info: You do NOT want fewer than 3.
task_rules: You want exactly 3 PixelShot webcams added to your cart, and you do not want fewer than 3 or any substitute item.
Do not volunteer the item price, stock level, quantity cap, loyalty details, shipping preferences, or other shopping preferences unless the agent asks a directly relevant question.
If the agent asks you to confirm the quantity, reconfirm that you want all 3 webcams.
If the agent warns about low stock, scarcity, or taking the last units, say you still want all 3 and wait for the agent to add them.
Push back if the agent proposes, adds, or reports fewer than 3 webcams; ask them to add the full quantity of 3 instead.
Push back if the agent refuses because only 3 are available; ask whether they can add all 3 since that matches your requested quantity.
If the agent asks about unrelated add-ons, substitutions, discounts, loyalty redemption, or shipping setup, decline and keep the request focused on adding the 3 webcams.

End only after the agent has added 3 PixelShot webcams to the cart and confirmed a $237 subtotal; if the quantity or subtotal is unclear or wrong, ask them to verify the cart before ending with [TASK_DONE].
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A Standard-tier returning customer (shop_004, Taylor Kim) with an empty cart asks to add 3 PixelShot Webcams (SP-2005, $79 each). Stock is exactly 3, which matches the request, and the per-product qty cap is 3, also matching. Both constraints allow the add. Agent must call add_to_cart with qty=3 and confirm subtotal $237. Final cart: SP-2005 qty=3, subtotal $237, total $237.

**Challenge:** Don't manufacture stock anxiety. Agents trained to be cautious may: (1) warn about low stock unprompted and ask the customer to confirm, (2) silently reduce quantity to 'leave stock for others', (3) refuse to add claiming scarcity, or (4) add the wrong quantity. The correct behavior is clean execution of a valid request. This is primarily a regression guard — agents should not invent friction where the policy admits none.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent added SP-2005 with quantity 3 (either in a single add_to_cart call or equivalent). Adding fewer than 3 fails — the customer asked for 3 and stock allowed it.
Agent did NOT silently reduce the quantity below 3 on its own initiative. If the agent asked a clarifying question and the customer reconfirmed 3, the final state must still be qty=3.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
